admit site home-b of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as community on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: claim the host
step 2: create /etc/paisans
step 3: record what admit installs
step 4: skip the mesh until its conf exists
step 5: start community's manager after the mesh
step 6: delegate cgroups to users
step 7: write the egress table
step 8: install the egress unit
step 9: load the egress table
step 10: load br_netfilter
step 11: load br_netfilter at boot

step 12: write community's daemon.json
  daemon: userland proxy off, address pools clear of the mesh; written as community
  run:
    $ runuser -u community -- env -i HOME='/home/community' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1002 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1002/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1002/docker.sock sh -c 'umask 077 && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/docker" && cat > "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" && mv -f "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" "$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json"'
  stdin:
    | {
    |   "userland-proxy": false,
    |   "default-address-pools": [
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.17.0.0/16",

step 13: install community's rootless Docker
step 14: create /srv/paisans

present: swap: on
present: docker: Engine 29.9.1
present: package: docker-ce-rootless-extras installed
present: package: uidmap installed
present: package: nftables installed
present: package: wireguard-tools installed
present: package: git installed
present: apparmor: rootlesskit's profile is loaded
present: user: community exists, uid 1002, in no privileged group, and sudo grants it nothing beyond admit's helper
present: user: community holds 231072-296607 in /etc/subuid
present: user: community holds 231072-296607 in /etc/subgid
present: egress: the host's on-link IPv6 prefixes, dropped: 2001:db8:1::/64
present: linger: on for community
present: linger: community's manager is running
present: br_netfilter: nf_tables, which the host's iptables uses, is loaded
present: mesh: nothing on this host overlaps 10.44.0.0/24
present: firewall: ufw active, its default policy left to the owner
present: forwarding: not needed, this site has no endpoint
warning: user: community already exists and is not paisans-f2a9
  admit adds the operators' keys to community's authorized_keys and runs the deployment as community: check that this account is meant for the deployment and nothing else.
warning: delegation reaches community's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
warning: daemon: /home/community has 8.0 GB free, under 20 GB for a data site
  Docker's images, layers and volumes live there, and on a data site its database and WAL archive, on a Garage site its objects. Give --data-dir a larger disk, or free space before the deployment fills it.
warning: watchdog: falling back to softdog
  the watchdog will be softdog. It reboots the host when Patroni hangs, but not when the kernel does, and a hung kernel cannot fence itself any other way. A hardware or hypervisor watchdog is better: enable one in the firmware or the VM's settings, and admit again.
warning: watchdog: community's Patroni can reboot this machine
  Patroni arms the watchdog and reboots the whole host when it stops renewing it, which is what makes its failover safe.
